summary: Watch broken-poster fallback after Owner Production V2.47.148. Poster image load failures no longer expose the browser broken-image glyph; Watch replaces failed images (including already-complete failed images and dynamically refreshed TMDB posters) with a local title-initial fallback while preserving Poster Shelf geometry. Shared image helpers, Shared Shell, Navigation and frozen Channels remain unchanged. No data model, schema, migration or updater change. Production remains Owner manual.
